verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.sprinto.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured documentation index (sprinto-probe-1), and llms.txt entries carry agent-friendly page summaries (sprinto-docs-19, sprinto-docs-20). Markdown versions of the docs are served and point back to llms.txt (sprinto-probe-2), with .md doc URLs used throughout (e.g. sprinto-docs-26, sprinto-docs-48). Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, no first-party guidance on pointing agents at the docs, and no independent user corroboration of agent use.
